title: Thai Veggie Ground Tacos with Sesame-Ginger Cucumber & Cabbage Salad

steps.text: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggie ground, curry paste, and soy sauce; cook, breaking the veggie ground apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, place dressing and miso paste in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine.
Wash, dry, trim, and small dice cucumber. Add to the bowl with the dressing along with the shredded cabbage. Stir to combine the salad and set aside.
Wash, dry, and cut lime into wedges; set aside for serving.
Warm taco shells in the microwave if desired.
Divide taco shells between plates, then fill with a small portion of the salad and veggie ground. Serve with remaining salad and lime wedges for squeezing. Enjoy!
